description:
A credential of another service the operator granted a third-party plugin, named by
the setting it is held under and never by its value.

at.description: When the operator approved it, as the record stamps every change.

credential.description: The setting the credential is held under, as the credentials read names it.

for.description: The capability of the plugin's own it was granted to fill.

of.description: The service whose credential it is.
